description: Extract shared DocumentProcessor persistence; extend Embedding.Client snapshot/retry/redaction options. Prove production parity, configured zaq_router routing, dimension and half-vector validation.

comments.text: Action reuse recheck: DocumentProcessor.store_chunk_with_metadata/3 owns embedding then private vector validation, language/search config/metadata and Repo.insert; Embedding.Client.embed/2 owns OpenAI-compatible HTTP with persisted System config. SearchKnowledgeBase Action is retrieval only; no agent Action owns offline corpus chunk writes. Benchmark runner will consume both through local APIs, no agent tool/workflow exposure. Validation: mix q passed; isolated selected 154 tests + 5 properties passed, including full DocumentProcessor suite, direct persistence tests, Client retry/redaction and configuration tests.
